params.name: last_offset
params.description:
Specifies a date/time (with timezone information) for continuing retrieval of events.
Events occuring _after_ the `last_offset` value provided will be returned.

params.name: event_count
params.description: Specifies the number of events to return. Default is 50, maximum value is 100.

params.name: ids
params.description: A comma separated list of event ids.

params.name: fields
params.description: A comma separated list of fields to return in the response.

params.name: editorial_segment
params.description: Filters to events with a matching editorial segment.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filters to events that start on or after this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., 1999-12-31). Defaults to UTC unless otherwise specified.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filters to events that start on or before this date. Use ISO 8601 format (e.g., 1999-12-31). Defaults to UTC unless otherwise specified.

params.name: fields
params.description: Specifies fields to return. Default set is 'id','name','start_date'.

params.name: page
params.description: Request results starting at a page number (default is 1, maximum is 50).

params.name: page_size
params.description: Request number of events to return in each page. Default is 30, maximum page_size is 100.

params.name: phrase
params.description: Filters to events related to this phrase

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Specifies the order in which to sort the results. Default is `newest`.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to search Getty Images news, sports and entertainment events. Getty Images photographers and videographers cover editorially-relevant events occurring around the world. All images or video clips produced in association with a specific event are assigned the same event ID. Event IDs are part of the metadata returned in Search results. Only content produced under a Getty Images brand name (Getty Images News, Getty Images Sports, Getty Images Entertainment, Film Magic, Wire Image)
